description: For every card of a deck's list (id or name) the user owns: how many copies, any printing, anywhere, claimed by a deck or not, and how many of those are proxies (by oracle_id; a card with no copy is left out, and deck_status names the cards). It counts what is owned, not what this deck may use: deck_status says that.
name: owned_counts

owned.description: Copies the user owns of the card: any printing, anywhere, claimed by a deck or not

proxies.description: Of owned: proxies, not real cards. Always say so beside the count.

title: Owned counts
